notes.title: PATCH - 18/MAR/2016 - Version: 1.1.0.43
notes.notes:
[IMG]http://i.imgur.com/hvEBkoQ.jpg[/IMG]

Version: 1.1.0.43 is now live and contains the following additions and changes.

This patch adds steam cloud saving, fixes a few small problems and changes a few things around a bit in the game's menu.

Full list of additions and changes:
[olist]
    [*]Steam cloud support.
    [*]Removed dl-tv Launcher.
    [*]Launcher puzzle moved to main menu.
    [*]Renamed tv puzzle achievement in steamworks.
    [*]Social icons moved to main menu.
    [*]Social icons open overlay instead of browser.
    [*]Updated pixel puzzles banners.
    [*]Pixel puzzles banners open overlay instead of browser.
    [*]Fixed screenshot colour correction error.
[/olist]
Enjoy!!!

notes.title: PATCH - 22/FEB/2016 - Version: 1.0.2.38
notes.notes:
[IMG]http://i.imgur.com/hwPX3fz.jpg[/IMG]

Version: 1.0.2.38 is now live and contains the following additions and changes.

This is just another quick little patch addressing a few requests to have an option to turn off puzzle piece rotation and having achievements retroactively activate if the puzzle was completed before the previous patch's achievement fix.

Full list of additions and changes:
[olist]
    [*]Option to turn off piece rotation in options menu.
    [*]Fixed options menu active option highlights not showing.
    [*]Achievements will now retroactively activate in the puzzle select menu if a puzzle was completed before the previous 1.0.1.37 patched version.
[/olist]
Enjoy!!!

notes.title: PATCH - 21/FEB/2016 - Version: 1.0.1.37
notes.notes:
[IMG]http://i.imgur.com/z1RuT0z.jpg[/IMG]

Version: 1.0.1.37 is now live and contains the following additions and changes.

This is just a quick patch addressing a few small issues found with some of the achievements not unlocking and puzzles not restarting after their second completion.

Full list of additions and changes:
[olist]
    [*]Fixed zoom not exiting when puzzle is complete.
    [*]Fixed puzzle complete achievement not activating when rocket launched.
    [*]Fixed puzzle not ending and restarting after second completion.
[/olist]
Enjoy!!!
